```{r,echo=FALSE}
pn = function(c,d){
    d = d[c!=0]
    c = c[c!=0]
    p = paste0("{",c,"}x^{",d,"}",collapse="+")
    p = gsub("x^{0}","",p,fixed=T)
    p = gsub("x^{1}","x",p,fixed=T)
    p = gsub("+{-","-{",p,fixed=T)
    p = gsub("+{1}x","+x",p,fixed=T)
    p = gsub("-{1}x","-x",p,fixed=T)
    p = gsub("{-1}x","-x",p,fixed=T)
    p = gsub("{1}x","x",p,fixed=T)
    return(p)
}

cn = function(real,imag){
    ss = paste0("{",real,"}+",imag,"i")
    ss = gsub("+-","-",ss,fixed=T)
    ss = gsub("+1i","+i",ss,fixed=T)
    ss = gsub("-1i","-i",ss,fixed=T)
    ss = gsub("+0i","",ss,fixed=T)
    ss = gsub("{0}+","",ss,fixed=T)
    ss = gsub("{0}-","",ss,fixed=T)
    ss = gsub("{","",ss,fixed=T)
    ss = gsub("}","",ss,fixed=T)
    return(ss)
}

rm = sample(2:9,2)*sample(c(-1,1),2,T)

R = rm[1]
M = rm[2]

cn1 = cn(R,M)
cn2 = cn(R,-M)

start = paste0("(x+",-R,"+",-M,"i)(x+",-R,"+",M,"i)",collapse = "")
start = gsub("+-","-",start,fixed=T)

## (x-R-Mi)(x-R+Mi)
# x^2 - 2*Rx + R^2+M^2

ach1 = pn(c(1,-2*R,R^2+M^2),2:0)
ach2 = pn(c(1,2*R,R^2+M^2),2:0)
ach3 = pn(c(1,-2*R,abs(R^2-M^2)),2:0)
ach4 = pn(c(1,2*R,abs(R^2-M^2)),2:0)

ach = sample(c(ach1,ach2,ach3,ach4))
al = paste0("* $",ach,"$",collapse="\n")
sol = paste0(1*(ach1==ach),collapse="")


```

Question
========

Expand the quadratic polynomial with complex roots into standard form.

$$`r start`$$

Answerlist

`r al`

Solution
========

The correct answer is $`r ach1`$.

Use a box.
